_source: Foundry Models meters, Azure Retail Prices API, Global Standard deployment, verified 2026-09-30 in eastus2. Meter names are exact; unitOfMeasure varies (1K vs 1M) and is read from the API at price time.
_deploymentNote: Prices default to Global Standard. Set deployment (global | datazone | regional) and processing (standard | batch | priority) to switch meter family; fineTuned bills the fine-tuned inference meters plus trainingTokens and hostingHours. Meter families are matched by normalised meter-name tokens, so a deployment/processing combination without a published meter is rejected rather than guessed.
